title: Morning Brief — Wednesday, 14 October 2026
description: National house prices keep climbing even as Sydney and Melbourne growth slows, Queensland tenders the next stage of the billion-dollar Cairns Hospital expansion, and the Gold Coast's tourism economy posts near-record domestic visitor numbers ahead of 2032. 한국어 방송도 이어집니다.

show.channel_description: A short daily news brief covering Australian national news, Queensland, and the Gold Coast — made to listen to on the morning drive.
